mapper.select: select b.create_date from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.element_id = #{elementId} order by b.create_date desc limit 1

select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.create_date) sort, c.id, a.element_id, b.user_id, b.role_name, b.role_type, b.record_time, b.record from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.element_id = #{elementId} order by b.create_date
select a.update_date from t_chat_room a where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.element_id = #{elementId}

select count(b.id) speakerCount, b.role_type name from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.element_id = #{elementId} and a.is_deleted = 0 group by b.role_type order by role_type

select count(b.id) speakerCount, b.role_name name from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.element_id = #{elementId} and b.role_type = #{roleType} and a.is_deleted = 0 group by b.role_name order by count(b.id) desc

select count(b.id) speakerCount, sum(b.word_number) wordCount, b.role_name, b.user_id, b.role_type from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.element_id = #{elementId} and a.is_deleted = 0 group by b.role_name, b.role_type, b.user_id order by count(b.id),sum(b.word_number) desc limit 10

select a.chat_room_id, b.id, b.role_name, b.record from t_chat_history a left join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.element_id = #{elementId} and b.consumption_status = false and a.is_deleted = 0 and b.role_type != #{roleType} and a.create_date between #{fiveMinutesAgo} and #{nowTime}

select avg(b.word_number) wordCount, b.role_name, b.user_id, b.role_type from t_chat_history a join t_chat_history_detail b on a.id = b.chat_history_id and b.is_deleted = 0 where a.element_id = #{elementId} and a.is_deleted = 0 and b.role_type is not null group by b.role_name, b.role_type, b.user_id order by avg(b.word_number) desc limit 10

SELECT a.element_id as elementId, SUM(b.word_number) as wordNumber FROM t_chat_history_detail b JOIN t_chat_history a ON b.chat_history_id = a.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.word_number IS NOT NULL AND b.role_type = 'MODEL' AND b.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.element_id
